articles.event_key: ESA|Euclid 望远镜发现新彗星|Euclid 首颗新彗星
articles.title: 欧几里得望远镜发现首颗此前未知彗星 C/2026 S1
articles.summary: ESA 称欧几里得望远镜在9月拍摄的图像中发现其首颗未知彗星，国际天文联合会小行星中心10月8日确认为 C/2026 S1，距地球约13亿公里。
articles.new_facts: 欧空局宣布欧几里得望远镜发现首颗此前未知彗星，编号 C/2026 S1 (Euclid)，发现团队将观测报告提交国际天文联合会小行星中心，经地面后续观测后于10月8日确认。
articles.limitations: 彗星轨道周期尚待更多数据修正；该彗星不适宜作为彗星拦截器任务目标。

facts.text: 欧洲空间局10月19日宣布，欧几里得空间望远镜在9月16日至24日拍摄的图像中发现其第一颗此前未知的彗星。发现团队中的 Mikko Pöntinen 将观测报告提交国际天文联合会小行星中心，经地面天文台后续观测，该中心于10月8日确认为彗星，编号 C/2026 S1 (Euclid)。

evidence.quote: The European Space Agency’s Euclid space telescope has discovered its first previously unknown comet, in images taken between 16 and 24 September 2026.
The MPC subsequently confirmed it as a comet on 8 October, and it is now identified as C/2026 S1 (Euclid).

facts.text: 该彗星距地球约13亿公里，位于行星轨道平面之外，绕太阳一周需数千年。欧几里得本为测绘深空星系设计，会刻意避开尘埃密集的太阳系平面，且采用步进凝视方式通常只观测每片天区一次，因此发现新彗星并不容易。

evidence.quote: The comet is located approximately 1.3 billion kilometres away from Earth, equivalent to the distance from the Sun to roughly between the orbits of Jupiter and Saturn.

Euclid deliberately avoids the asteroid- and comet-rich band of sky along the Solar System’s plane to reduce unwanted glare from dust that would hinder sensitive deep-sky imaging, making the discovery of new Solar System objects particularly challenging.

facts.text: ESA 表示，这颗彗星不适合作为其未来彗星拦截器任务的目标，但此次发现与预警流程为两个任务团队的后续协作提供了实战检验。

evidence.quote: While this particular comet is not a suitable candidate for Comet Interceptor, the process of discovery and alert gives us a real test case for how our two mission teams will coordinate in the future.

bilingual.title_en: Euclid Telescope Discovers First Previously Unknown Comet, C/2026 S1

sentences.en: The European Space Agency announced on October 19 that the Euclid space telescope had discovered its first previously unknown comet in images taken between September 16 and 24.
sentences.zh: 欧洲空间局10月19日宣布，欧几里得空间望远镜在9月16日至24日拍摄的图像中发现其第一颗此前未知的彗星。

sentences.en: Mikko Pöntinen of the discovery team submitted the observation report to the International Astronomical Union's Minor Planet Center, and after follow-up observations by ground-based observatories, the center confirmed it as a comet on October 8, designated C/2026 S1 (Euclid).
sentences.zh: 发现团队中的 Mikko Pöntinen 将观测报告提交国际天文联合会小行星中心，经地面天文台后续观测，该中心于10月8日确认为彗星，编号 C/2026 S1 (Euclid)。

sentences.en: The comet is about 1.3 billion kilometers from Earth, lies outside the plane of the planets' orbits, and takes several thousand years to complete one orbit around the Sun.
sentences.zh: 该彗星距地球约13亿公里，位于行星轨道平面之外，绕太阳一周需数千年。

sentences.en: Euclid was designed to map deep-space galaxies, deliberately avoids the dust-rich plane of the solar system, and uses a step-and-stare method that typically observes each patch of sky only once, so discovering a new comet is not easy.
sentences.zh: 欧几里得本为测绘深空星系设计，会刻意避开尘埃密集的太阳系平面，且采用步进凝视方式通常只观测每片天区一次，因此发现新彗星并不容易。

sentences.en: ESA said the comet is not suitable as a target for its future Comet Interceptor mission, but the discovery and warning process provided a real-world test for follow-up collaboration between the two mission teams.
sentences.zh: ESA 表示，这颗彗星不适合作为其未来彗星拦截器任务的目标，但此次发现与预警流程为两个任务团队的后续协作提供了实战检验。
